# Where to Watch Young Warriors


by Angel | November 5, 2026


When a mother's sudden mental illness pushes a father and son to their breaking point, ten-year-old Junior refuses to lose hope.


*Young Warriors* is a heartwarming story about family, friendship and faith. Junior and his friends each face their own struggles at home, and they find strength in each other along the way. It's a story about love, redemption and the kind of healing that takes time.


[Stream Young Warriors on Angel today.](https://www.angel.com/watch/young-warriors)


#### A Ten-Year-Old Who Won't Give Up


Junior is young, but he understands more than most kids his age. He sees what his mom is going through. He sees how heavy it is for his dad. And he chooses hope when it would be easier to give up.


That choice drives the story. Junior doesn't have all the answers, and the movie doesn't pretend he does. What he has is determination, and a belief that his family isn't out of options.


The result is a story that feels honest about hard things while still leaving room for light.


#### Faith, Prayer and Perseverance


At its core, *Young Warriors* is a story of faith, love, hope and redemption. It shows how prayer and steady perseverance can carry a family through its hardest season, and how healing can find its way in.


The movie doesn't rush its message. It lets the characters struggle, hope, and keep going. For families who want a story that treats faith with care, it offers a lot to talk about together.


It also speaks to kids and parents alike. Younger viewers can see themselves in Junior's courage. Adults may find something to hold onto, too.


#### What Guild Members Are Saying


Angel Guild members have responded warmly to *Young Warriors* . Many point to how relatable it feels, especially from a child's point of view.


"This movie really touched home from a child's perspective. This film was very relatable and applicable to the current situations that are actually happening to children." — Marc Whelan, Angel Guild


Others say the movie handles its subject with depth. One member put it this way:


"This was deeper and more realistic than most Christian movies that touch on these topics." — Jennifer Brandt, Angel Guild


#### Watch *Young Warriors* on Angel


A boy who won't give up. Friends who stand by him. A family learning that healing is possible. *Young Warriors* tells a story of faith and hope that's meant to be shared.


[Watch Young Warriors now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/young-warriors)
